sectors.name: Technology
themes: Indonesia's digital economy is compounding via rising fintech and e-commerce penetration, making local tech leaders like DIVA structural beneficiaries of domestic consumption shifts.
Global AI infrastructure spending remains a durable capex cycle, lifting US mega-caps (ORCL, MSFT, META) and creating spillover demand for regional cloud and data-center services.
Regulatory tailwinds for digitalization in Indonesia—including payment-system modernization and SME digitization—provide a policy-backed floor for local tech valuations.
sectors.ai: Buy selective Indonesian tech exposure into strength: local names (2454, DIVA) lead on domestic catalysts while US mega-caps (META, MSFT, ORCL) confirm global AI demand. Rotate from laggards to leaders with earnings momentum; hold through normal volatility, adding on dips toward support. Prioritize names with clear AI monetization or local digital-payment traction.

Government push for energy security and EV battery supply chains accelerates M&A and capex in copper-gold and nickel assets, favoring AMMN and FPNI as long-term compounders.

Consolidation in halal-certified and premium packaged foods is accelerating, as larger players acquire niche brands to capture rising middle-class spending on quality.
sectors.ai: Buy selective momentum in small-cap consumer names (JELI, IATA, BACH) as liquidity rotates into high-beta FMCG, but lock gains into large-cap staples (NEST, ICBP) for stability. The sector's aggregate +0.60% masks divergence; US strength (+1.48%) supports export-linked food names. Favor names with earnings catalysts, avoid laggards without volume.

sectors.ai: Buy healthcare selectively: Indonesian hospitals (SILO, PRIM) are re-rating on JKN volume recovery and private-pay mix shift, while US medtech (ISRG, BSX, BAX) benefits from procedural rebound and GLP-1 tailwinds. Regulatory tailwinds from government digital infrastructure spending and local content quotas are accelerating monetization for domestic platforms, reducing reliance on volatile global ad cycles.

sectors.name: Crypto & Digital Assets
themes: Indonesia's crypto tax and Bappebti licensing regime remains a structural drag, capping local exchange volumes and forcing institutional flows offshore.
US macro easing and spot ETF inflows are the dominant global driver, transmitting volatility to IDX-listed fintech proxies rather than direct crypto exposure.
Stablecoin adoption for cross-border trade and remittance is a durable local growth vector, outpacing speculative altcoin demand in Indonesia.
sectors.ai: Buy the US-led crypto rebound selectively: BTC-linked and liquid alts (ADA, DOT, ALGO) are outperforming on risk-on flows, but Indonesia's regulatory overhang and thin local liquidity cap upside. Rotate into HELOC and ENA for yield-driven momentum, trim ZEC/HYPE on low conviction. Maintain 5-10% tactical allocation, hedge with USD stablecoins.
